excerpt.en: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.

texts.zh: 环绕[From.GetName]的众多卫星之一有一个终结轨道。它即将与气态巨行星相撞，这无疑会造成极大的破坏。这将是数百万年一遇的奇观，更巧合的是，这次撞击恰好在我们的一艘飞船拜访那里之后发生。许多科学家都想亲临现场观测和记录这次事件，但这样的碰撞转瞬即逝，因此留给我们的时间并不多。
texts.en:
One of the many moons circling [From.GetName] has a terminal orbit. It will soon collide with the gas giant in what is sure to become a massive impact event. This event has been millions of years in the making, and it is a startling coincidence that the impact has been fated to occur just after a visit by one of our ships.

Many of our scientists wish to observe and record the event, but we only have a narrow window before it is too late.

texts.zh: 环绕[From.GetName]的卫星之一将会撞击这个气态巨行星的表面。这个极为罕见的奇景将会被记载下来流传后世。
texts.en: One of the moons circling [From.GetName] will soon impact the surface of the gas giant. This extremely rare event should be recorded for posterity.

texts.zh: 我们成功的从不同角度记录了[CollisionLocation.GetName]和卫星相撞的奇观，并且对区域内的所有观众进行了现场直播。更重要的是，我们的科学家在[Root.GetLeaderName]的带领下记录了大量珍贵的物理数据，这对研究毫无疑问是有帮助的。
texts.en: We were successful in our attempt to record the collision between [CollisionLocation.GetName] and its moon! The event was captured from several different angles, and transmitted live throughout our space. Most importantly, our scientists under the leadership of [Root.GetLeaderName] were able to record a large amount of valuable physics data that will surely benefit our research.

# 终结轨道 / Terminal Orbit

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:744; events/anomaly_events_2.txt:797 (anomaly.2570); common/special_projects/00_projects_1.txt (TERMINAL_ORBIT_PROJECT); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:831 (anomaly.2571)

## 如何开始 How it starts

非卫星的气态巨行星可能生成（5级，权重3）。

Can spawn on a gas giant that is not a moon (level 5, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 anomaly.2570“终结轨道”：设置国家标志 terminal_divination_flag，选项启用项目 TERMINAL_ORBIT_PROJECT“观测卫星撞击”（科学船+科学家，需180天，限时1080天），完成后 anomaly.2571：领袖+300经验与每月物理研究加成。

Single result anomaly.2570 "Terminal Orbit": sets country flag terminal_divination_flag; the option enables project TERMINAL_ORBIT_PROJECT (science ship and scientist, 180 days, time limit 1080 days). Completion fires anomaly.2571: leader +300 experience and monthly physics research.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一路径；项目超时（1080天）后没有后续事件（项目没有 on_fail）。

Single path; if the project times out (1080 days) nothing follows (the project has no on_fail).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

2570 与 2571 的描述有生物舰船变体。

2570 and 2571 have bio-ship description variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义、项目与全部结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。

Checked the anomaly definition, the project and every outcome event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed.
